research_question: Can any continuously rotated XZ-plane Jordan-Wigner parity frame expose an additional exact quadratic-Majorana conserved operator that the five R197 frames missed?

continuous_frame.parameter: t in the real projective line
orientation_checks: P dot P = Q dot Q = R dot R = 1
P dot Q = Q dot R = R dot P = 0

symbolic_certificate.candidate_columns: all 2n Majorana-linear operators, all choose(2n,2) Hermitian quadratic bilinears, and full parity; identity and H are omitted because they are the two known commuting directions
symbolic_certificate.column_scaling: multiply every k-local-axis Jordan-Wigner monomial by D(t)^k, which is strictly positive for real t
symbolic_certificate.commutator: expand the exact integer-polynomial [H,O]/(2i) Pauli-word matrix
symbolic_certificate.minor_rule: at each anchor select the lexicographically first full-rank output-row basis, then compute its primitive exact ZZ[t] determinant
symbolic_certificate.adaptive_factor_rule: factor the primitive gcd of all accepted maximal minors; for each irreducible factor with a real root, row-reduce the complete matrix over QQ[t]/factor, add the lexicographically selected full-rank quotient-field minor, and repeat
symbolic_certificate.finite_real_acceptance: the square-free primitive final gcd has zero real roots by an exact Sturm/root-count calculation
symbolic_certificate.projective_endpoint_acceptance: the t=infinity frame has full candidate-column commutator rank under both declared primes

rational_frame_pressure.catalog_rule: enumerate all primitive integer pairs (u,v) in [-7,7]^2 excluding (0,0), map to c=(u^2-v^2)/(u^2+v^2), s=2uv/(u^2+v^2), deduplicate exact (c,s), sort lexicographically, and assign pxz_000 onward
rational_frame_pressure.row_acceptance: the exact rational Clifford-monomial operator basis is independent and every commutator matrix has full candidate-column rank under both declared primes

positive_control.rule: the pool has nonzero commutator nullity and contains all six explicit onsite tilted-field charges as commuting in-span witnesses

independent_audit.representation: independent sparse symplectic Pauli bit pairs, separately reconstructed polynomial and rational axes, and an independently selected third-prime row reduction
required_checks: the public-freeze ancestry and contract hash
all continuous-certificate determinant and gcd digests
all exact real-root counts and projective endpoint ranks
all 432 rational-frame row dimensions and matrix digests
the positive-control nullity and six explicit witnesses

allowed_if_all_rows_pass: for both frozen couplings and n=4,5, no additional exact conserved operator exists inside the continuously rotated XZ-plane quadratic-Majorana-plus-parity family
for both frozen couplings and n=6,8,10, no additional exact conserved operator exists in any of the 72 declared rational XZ-plane frames
the R197 candidate survives this declared continuous-family and rational-grid adversary
